Green Bay has shown considerable resilience at home, utilizing an efficient ground game to control the clock and keep games competitive. While Dallas boasts the sharper execution in high-leverage situations, Lambeau Field provides a tough environment that usually narrows expected margins. The Packers' defensive front should generate enough pressure to stall a few drives and keep the final score within a field goal either way. Ultimately, the Cowboys make one more explosive play down the stretch to secure the outright victory while Green Bay covers the narrow home spread.

Over Under: Both teams feature high-powered offenses that rank in the upper tier of the league in plays per minute and red-zone conversion rates. Favorable early-autumn weather conditions at Lambeau Field will facilitate clean execution and explosive passing plays from both quarterbacks. Given the defensive vulnerabilities each secondary has displayed this season, this matchup is primed to comfortably exceed the 50.5-point total.

Splits: Based on public tendencies, approximately 62% of spread bets are currently backing the road favorite Dallas Cowboys while the remaining 38% support the home underdog Green Bay Packers. The point spread has shifted down slightly from an opener of 2.5 to 1.5 at FanDuel in favor of Green Bay, while the total has held steady at 50.5 points.
